candidates.name: Tuberculosis
support_spans: a dry cough
an induced sputum was trace positive for MTB on GeneXpert and subsequently grew MTB sensitive to rifampicin and isoniazid
Biopsy of the toe ulcer showed necrotizing granulomatous inflammation with a solitary acid-fast bacillus
contradict_spans: He had two sputum GeneXpert tests at local clinics, both negative
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and test results, including the positive GeneXpert and biopsy findings, are consistent with a diagnosis of tuberculosis.

candidates.name: Pott's disease
support_spans: chronic lower back pain without neurologic deficits
MRI of the spine revealed contiguous spondylitis from T6 to T10 with discitis and an epidural/paraspinal collection causing spinal cord compression
candidates.why: The patient's lower back pain and MRI findings are consistent with Pott's disease, a form of tuberculosis that affects the spine.

candidates.name: Renal tuberculosis
support_spans: urine protein-creatinine ratio 0.242 g/mmol; dipstick: 3+ leukocytes, 3+ red blood cells; microscopy: granular casts
candidates.why: The patient's urinary findings, including proteinuria and hematuria, are consistent with renal tuberculosis.

candidates.name: Spondyloarthritis
support_spans: chronic lower back pain without neurologic deficits
tenderness over the thoracic spine but no neurologic deficits
contradict_spans: MRI of the spine revealed contiguous spondylitis from T6 to T10 with discitis and an epidural/paraspinal collection causing spinal cord compression

candidates.name: Chronic Kidney Disease
support_spans: urine protein-creatinine ratio 0.242 g/mmol; dipstick: 3+ leukocytes, 3+ red blood cells; microscopy: granular casts
contradict_spans: Renal ultrasound demonstrated normal-sized kidneys with increased echogenicity
candidates.why: The patient's urine test results suggest kidney damage or disease, but the renal ultrasound findings are not conclusive.
